Fully funded Postdoc Position at University Hamburg

We are looking for a postdoctoral researcher with strong computational expertise and an interest in normative, diversity-aware algorithmic systems. You are responsible for the computational core of the ERC-funded project “Which Public Sphere System for Democracy? (PSS4DEMOCRACY)”. This project introduces a fundamentally new way of studying the public sphere by designing and testing models of algorithmic news supply that translate normative democratic ideals into experimentally observable news environments.

More information and access to the online application form can be found here: Research Associate for the Project “Which Public Sphere System for Democracy? – PSS4DEMOCRACY” (Postdoc) § 28 Subsection 3 HmbHG : Job advertisement : Job opportunities : University of Hamburg<
> We would appreciate you sharing this offer with potential candidates.
